featured_reviews.name: Reena Dhila
featured_reviews.review_text:
Vikrant Sir is a rare kind of teacher whose creativity flows not only through his art, but through the hearts of his students. His class is not just a place to learn painting, it is a space where children are gently guided to discover their own inner artist. Over the years, he has helped many children move closer to their dreams, nurturing their confidence along with their skills.
When I joined his classes, the experience was truly enriching and joyful. Vikrant Sir teaches with immense patience, allowing each child the freedom to explore, experiment, and express themselves. At the same time, his guidance is always present — quiet, observant, and deeply thoughtful. This beautiful balance makes every session feel safe, inspiring, and meaningful.
I sincerely wish that many more parents and children find their way to this class and experience the magic it holds. I truly believe that the word heart carries art within it, and when art is nurtured with such care, the heart naturally becomes happy. If you are looking for a class that touches both skill and soul, Vikrant Sir’s art class is a wonderful place to begin.

featured_reviews.name: Suman Addepalli
featured_reviews.review_text:
I knew I had found a special resin artist when, six months ago, I booked a one-on-one session and received a refund without even asking, because she was unwell on the day of the workshop. That integrity stayed with me.

Cut to March 7, 2026… There were so many resin artists conducting workshops across Mumbai on that weekend, but something told me Trupti would teach us more than just the craft.

She is incredibly talented, doesn’t post much on Instagram, and is far prettier in person than her DP would suggest. 🙂

The two-day class (March 7–8) was full of laughter, giggles, and nonstop jokes.

I had secretly planned this workshop as a Women’s Day surprise for my sister: she lives and works in the US while I’m as busy in the Indian corporate world. Craft has always been something that we both love.

To make things more dramatic, my sisters flights got booked immediately (after a short delay) and I put Trupti under quite a bit of time pressure. Yet she made it all happen in the nth hour, arranging materials, conducting the workshop on March 7–8, and even getting the clocks inserted professionally.

Yes, a few decor items were missing thanks to my design request, but Trupti is wonderfully jugaadu—resourceful, creative, and always focused on teaching the nuances while keeping the atmosphere light and fun.

If deep, beautiful resin creations are something you’re looking for, Trupti is definitely the artist and facilitator to go to.

Thank you, Trupti, for making this experience so memorable.

#Mumbai #ResinArtist  #ResinArt

I am thoroughly enjoying this course. It has proved useful in boosting my confidence in both drawing and  painting as well as providing me with inspiration for my own work. An incredible experience for a senior citizen like me which not only helps me in overcoming stress but in getting inovative ideas. Sir is a great teacher, he patiently showed my many techniques to practice to improve my drawing and painting skills. Madam is equally an efficient person not only as teacher but also has a great skill and patience in both teaching and other issues. With the guidance of both of them I have been able to make a few drawings which has really given me a great satisfaction.
I really feel that people of my age and having inclination to do something in their so called idle life should definitely take up drawing & painting course at this academy to prove their talent.
My heartfelt thanks to both Sir and Madam in helping me out in finding out my capabilities.

featured_reviews.name: Smruti
featured_reviews.review_text: Joining Juilon Drawing classes was a great choice. Even though I have just started, the experience is getting more and more of fun and of always learning something new. Lokking at the beautiful paintings done by our Sir, Ma'am and some students too is really exciting and inspiring. I hope I will do it longer. I also hope for a lot of other people to join and get this beautiful experience of art.

featured_reviews.name: Moaaza Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text: I am a student of juilon drawing classes for certian time . Sir and ma'am both are very friendly , they are professional and have a lot love and respect for their art . Running this art class is their hobby and they do work with a lot of enthusiasm . They keep a lot of different workshops and keep students to learn new things through workshops. The atmosphere of the class is is normally very friendly and children injoys it. Students come from a very young age and they also have aldut students . Children learn a lot ,  they are very responsible and know real value of art and talent. The work their is in professional way and plus a friendly way . Its a well and great doing class for students.
